title: Always stay on top behavior not working correctly

judgment.rationale: The report gives a direct current-version sequence and a clear expected/actual result. A maintainer reproduction can distinguish a Dock-specific topmost regression from an interaction with fullscreen or window activation policy.
evidence: The reporter identifies Command Palette Dock and version 0.101.2652.0.
The steps enable Always stay on top, open another normal or maximized application, and observe the Dock.
The expected behavior is topmost placement except during fullscreen; the reported behavior is that the Dock goes behind ordinary windows.
The reporter states the behavior is reproducible.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce on a current build with normal, maximized, and fullscreen windows, then inspect the Dock topmost update path if ordinary-window coverage fails.

fix_assessment.rationale: A code fix may be applicable, but the lightweight pass does not establish whether the failure is in the setting, window activation handling, monitor lifecycle, or fullscreen exception logic.

issue_context.summary: Command Palette Dock reportedly loses topmost placement over ordinary windows even though Always stay on top is enabled.
known_information: The issue targets Command Palette on PowerToys 0.101.2652.0 from the Microsoft Store.
Always stay on top is enabled in Dock settings.
The reporter observes the Dock behind another normal or maximized application.
Fullscreen behavior is explicitly intended to be an exception.
No diagnostic archive or discussion follow-up is attached.
inferences: The failure may be caused by topmost state not being reapplied after activation or by an overly broad fullscreen/window-state check.
A controlled repro with ordinary and fullscreen windows can separate those possibilities.
issue_context.analysis: The issue is specific enough to reproduce without asking the reporter for generic logs. The next discriminating evidence is the Dock window state across ordinary, maximized, and fullscreen transitions.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue body and confirmed there are no comments or attachments.
Recorded the explicit fullscreen exception so reproduction does not treat expected fullscreen behavior as a failure.

prerequisites: One ordinary window and one maximized window available
A fullscreen application available to verify the documented exception
steps: Open Command Palette Dock settings and enable Always stay on top.
Open an ordinary application window and verify whether the Dock remains above it.
Repeat with a maximized but non-fullscreen window.
Enter fullscreen in a test application and record whether the Dock hides as expected.
Leave fullscreen and check whether the Dock returns above ordinary windows.
If the failure reproduces, capture the Dock window state before and after each transition.
reproduce.expected_result: The Dock remains above ordinary and maximized non-fullscreen windows, may hide during fullscreen, and returns to topmost placement after leaving fullscreen.
setup_requirements: Record PowerToys version and installation scope.
Record which window transition first causes the Dock to lose topmost placement.
